shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index dropped 9 points or 0.02 percent on Friday to close at 53560 points.Losses were led by Nvidia (-4.45%), 3M (-2.56%) and Honeywell International (-2.19%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Amazon (4.02%), Salesforce (3.06%) and Nike (3.02%).

children: The Dow Jones Index dropped 9 points or 0.02 percent on Friday to close at 53560 points.

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.02% Lower
